scientific_and_authority_limits: Finite fixed-grid certificates, including exhaustive NO_GRID, never establish or refute unrestricted continuous-time LRC.
A PASS authenticates bounded arithmetic and tree coverage under the pinned local collector; hashes alone do not attest interpreter identity or compromised host/database administration.
Solver plus two fresh role prompts are separate contexts, not expert peer review, formal proof or different-model foundations. Role model names are requested CLI provenance only.
Ledger v4 prospective root binding preserves historical v1-v3 absent-field JSON/digest semantics; it does not retrofit prior evidence or regrade old cases.
No paid API authority, dependency/migration, Git publication, theorem promotion, automatic human acceptance or unbounded LRC campaign is added.
